newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY GANG REVENGES TAKE NEW VICTIM.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY GANG REVENGES TAKE NEW VICTIM.

text.p: A spate of bombings and shootings continued in Hungary Saturday night when a 28-year-old entrepreneur was shot to death in the southern Hungarian town Szeged, the MTI news agency said on Sunday.
The man, who had been involved in several criminal proceedings, was shot eight times after getting off his car in front of his home, and died on the spot, MTI said.
A handgrenade, thrown by the murderer or dropped by the victim, also blew up close to the man.
Police sources quoted by MTI said the attack was probably a revenge action. The police declined to say more.

Before the Saturday case at least three people were killed in a spate of bombings and shootings that began in Hungary last September, many of them targeted at the capital Budapest's nightspots, bars and car dealerships.
Most people killed or injured in the attacks were entrepreneurs well-known by the police. The police said many of the cases was due to a war of gangs.
Interior Minister Gabor Kuncze said one week ago that after a major shake-up police are dealing more effectively with the violence wave that has rocked Hungary.
